header: An icon, a title and one sentence
lead: The standard feature grid, in two, three or four columns. The card style gives each cell a surface; the plain style sets the same cells straight on the band.

items.title: Two, three or four columns
items.text: The editor’s count holds on wide screens. Tablets show two columns and phones one.

items.title: Card or plain
items.text: The card style lifts each cell onto a surface. The plain style drops it and keeps everything else.

items.title: Icons chosen by name
items.text: Editors pick an icon from one shared set, and the theme draws it in Lucide.

items.title: A real list
items.text: The cells are list items, so a screen reader announces how many features there are.

items.title: One link per cell
items.text: Give a cell a link and the whole card becomes the target. The title names it for screen readers.

items.title: Equal heights in a row
items.text: Each card stretches to the tallest one beside it, so icons and titles line up.
